purpose: Existing Deskpilot capabilities to retain when implementing the navigation redesign. Prototype controls use example data only.

integration_contract.intent: A proper Herdr integration that adds to Deskpilot without replacing or reducing Deskpilot's existing uses.
integration_contract.herdr: A clearly labeled Herdr area preserves native spaces, tabs, split membership, order and management actions. Native identity is never inferred from a name or folder.
integration_contract.deskpilot: Ordinary sessions and supported conversations stay outside Herdr groups. Desktop, previews, pairing, devices, notifications, usage and installation retain clear access.
integration_contract.shared: Machine selection, consistent status language, terminal rendering, input tools and navigation are shared. A machine without Herdr remains a complete Deskpilot experience.
integration_contract.presentation: Keep familiar Deskpilot session cards first, with session name, status, desktop screen and path. Herdr has a visibly separate native area with space headers, selectable tabs, pane rows and scoped management. Regular sessions never acquire Herdr spaces or tabs.
integration_contract.latest_review: deskpilot-separation.html; review-separation.html is its browser wrapper
integration_contract.scope: Implemented and activated after review; prototypes remain as design history.

features: create session with directory, editable command, presets, and desktop placement
add a terminal inside a tab
list affected running work before close
last tab closure also closes space
herdr_management_proposed.status: Native create/rename/reorder/split/close and exact-pane stop implemented. Cross-space tab transfer is unavailable in the installed Herdr API and explicitly labeled in the UI.

features: composer and unsent drafts per machine/session
return to originating work list or desktop workspace
request-specific approval only when explicitly supported
connect supported conversations from their window
preserve independently published artifacts when no exact terminal association exists

authorized_devices: upgrade shared legacy key to individual credential

behavior_to_preserve: no lost drafts during polling or route changes
resume selected machine/session after phone reload
no replay of actions on resume
late requests cannot target a newly selected machine
review_note: The feature inventory is the implementation parity reference. A clickable example is not evidence of backend support or a real permission/camera/push/terminal operation.
